stair._ruling: R-C9-145 (Matt) + R-C9-148 (Matt, from the walk film: 'the stairs seem to be below the sea cave which doesnt make alot of sense'): the cave sits in the MAIN south cliff face under p03's patch with a ledge at sea level; a straight stair (5.0 m wide since R-C9-154) climbs FROM that ledge UP the face to a top landing flush with the floor edge at p03's patch; open on the sea side; its run angles across the face (the 'aligned to centre' rule is dropped by R-C9-148); climbers turn toward the centre on the landing

top_landing.north_edge: follows the floor boundary vertex-for-vertex (flush, same z as the floor) at p03's patch

flight.polygon_order: top wall-side, top sea-side, foot sea-side, foot wall-side
flight.walk_model: a REAL RAMP: one plane under the step nosings, the same slope as the treads' pitch line; the steps are a visual on it. Godot CharacterBody3D floor_max_angle default 45 deg > the slope, so a body walks it without a step-up solver
flight.stair_rule_check: 2R + T = 0.620 m (the comfortable band is 0.60-0.65 m)

bottom_landing.note: the rock ledge at sea level in front of the cave; the flight's foot stands on it

stair.open_side: SOUTH (the sea side): no wall, no rail
stair.wall_side: NORTH: the main cliff face (stair_wall_rock fills the face between the straight flight and the curved lip)
stair.placement: OUTSIDE the floor polygon (it climbs the cliff face). The sim never reads it; it is the visible delivery path from the cave to the p03 patch.

features.note: the main cliff face between the curved lip and the straight flight: the stair's wall (outside the edge)

the sea-cave mouth (R-C9-154): 9.5 m wide x 6.9 m high in the MAIN south cliff face under p03's patch, at the stair's foot, on the sea-level ledge; it follows the lip; a 0.3 m rock lintel stays above it (sized for the servitor insectoids 4-8 m long and the 5.6 m nemesis)
